rows: Facts only, nothing dressed up. Wait for the athletic moment, it is the point of the match.
Say it straight, and I will answer straight. Turning up, every time, is the reputation I want.
It hurts to be treated as a novelty rather than a wrestler. I will not promise moves beyond my control.
The crowd can keep its applause; the result is what counts. I back off to what I am sure I can deliver.
I want to be the one people choose when they need a steady hand. Here is the list. There are two items.

I want to be trusted with the hard parts of a match.
Anything I attempt will be done with the other wrestler in mind. Facts only, nothing dressed up.
The crowd will gasp at the move that is coming.
Nobody speaks for me without asking. There is an athletic peak in this match you will not forget.
